metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: GEWFIZ crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C110 H196 Ce10 Mn8 O72,C104 H182 Ce10 Mn8 O72,8(C3 H8 O1),2(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Ce1 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce2 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce3 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce4 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce5 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Mn1 (Mn) has 6 O neighbors; Mn2 (Mn) has 6 O neighbors; Mn3 (Mn) has 6 O neighbors; Mn4 (Mn) has 5 O neighbors; Ce1B (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce2B (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce3B (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce4B (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce5B (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Mn1B (Mn) has 6 O neighbors; Mn2B (Mn) has 6 O neighbors; Mn3B (Mn) has 6 O neighbors; Mn4B (Mn) has 5 O neighbors; Ce6 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce7 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce8 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce9 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce10 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Mn5 (Mn) has 6 O neighbors; Mn6 (Mn) has 5 O neighbors; Mn7 (Mn) has 6 O neighbors; Mn8 (Mn) has 6 O neighbors; Ce6B (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce7B (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce8B (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce9B (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce10B (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Mn5B (Mn) has 6 O neighbors; Mn6B (Mn) has 5 O neighbors; Mn7B (Mn) has 6 O neighbors; Mn8B (Mn) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 98 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.233-4.002 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 90.55-136.52°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Ce10Mn8O18(ib)26(H2O)2]·[Ce10Mn8O18(ib)26(nPrOH)2]·8nPrOH·2H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
